entities.sql:
USE Migration_Staging;

TRUNCATE TABLE mid.Users;

INSERT INTO mid.Users (
    user_id,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    email,
    role,
    office,
    is_active
)
SELECT
    r.RecruiterID                                                                        AS user_id,
    LEFT(r.Fullname, CHARINDEX(' ', r.Fullname + ' ') - 1)                               AS first_name,
    NULLIF(LTRIM(SUBSTRING(r.Fullname, CHARINDEX(' ', r.Fullname + ' ') + 1, 200)), '')  AS last_name,
    r.email                                                                              AS email,
    LOWER(ro.Description)                                                                AS role,
    NULL                                                                                 AS office,
    1                                                                                    AS is_active
FROM Cobaltdesk_Legacy.dbo.Recruiter r
LEFT JOIN Cobaltdesk_Legacy.dbo.Roles ro ON ro.Role_ID = r.Role_ID;

fields.default: CASE WHEN a.Deleted = 1 THEN 'deleted' ELSE LOWER(st.Description) END

USE Migration_Staging;

TRUNCATE TABLE mid.Clients;

INSERT INTO mid.Clients (
    client_id,
    company_name,
    industry,
    website,
    phone,
    address_line_1,
    address_line_2,
    city,
    postcode,
    country,
    status,
    owner_user_id,
    created_at
)
SELECT
    a.Account_ID                                                           AS client_id,
    a.Account_name                                                         AS company_name,
    a.Industry                                                             AS industry,
    a.Website                                                              AS website,
    COALESCE(ad.WorkPhone, ad.Phone)                                       AS phone,
    ad.Address_line1                                                       AS address_line_1,
    ad.Address_line2                                                       AS address_line_2,
    ad.City                                                                AS city,
    ad.ZipCode                                                             AS postcode,
    ad.Country                                                             AS country,

    a.CreatedAt                                                            AS created_at
FROM Cobaltdesk_Legacy.dbo.Accounts a
LEFT JOIN Cobaltdesk_Legacy.dbo.Addresses ad ON ad.AddressID = a.AddressID
LEFT JOIN Cobaltdesk_Legacy.dbo.AccountStatus st ON st.Account_StatusID = a.AccountStatusTypeID;

USE Migration_Staging;

TRUNCATE TABLE mid.Contacts;

INSERT INTO mid.Contacts (
    contact_id,
    client_id,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    job_title,
    email,
    phone,
    mobile,
    status,
    owner_user_id,
    created_at
)
SELECT
    s.AssociateID                                             AS contact_id,
    co.AccountID                                              AS client_id,
    p.First_Name                                              AS first_name,
    p.Last_Name                                               AS last_name,
    s.Associate_Tag                                           AS job_title,
    ad.Email                                                  AS email,
    ad.WorkPhone                                              AS phone,
    ad.Phone                                                  AS mobile,
    CASE WHEN s.Active = 1 THEN 'active' ELSE 'inactive' END  AS status,
    s.CreatedBy                                               AS owner_user_id,
    s.CreatedAt                                               AS created_at
FROM Cobaltdesk_Legacy.dbo.Associates s
LEFT JOIN Cobaltdesk_Legacy.dbo.Person p ON p.Person_ID = s.Person_ID
LEFT JOIN Cobaltdesk_Legacy.dbo.Addresses ad ON ad.AddressID = s.Associate_AddressID
OUTER APPLY (SELECT MIN(aa.AccountID) AS AccountID FROM Cobaltdesk_Legacy.dbo.AccountAssociates aa WHERE aa.AssociateID = s.AssociateID) co;

entities.label: Candidates
entities.sql:
USE Migration_Staging;

TRUNCATE TABLE mid.Candidates;

INSERT INTO mid.Candidates (
    candidate_id,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    email,
    mobile,
    phone,
    current_job_title,
    current_employer,
    address_line_1,
    address_line_2,
    city,
    postcode,
    country,
    source,
    status,
    linkedin_url,
    owner_user_id,
    created_at
)
SELECT
    p.Person_ID                   AS candidate_id,
    p.First_Name                  AS first_name,
    p.Last_Name                   AS last_name,
    ad.Email                      AS email,
    ad.Phone                      AS mobile,
    NULLIF(ad.OtherPhone, '')     AS phone,
    cj.Title                      AS current_job_title,
    cj.PlaceofWork                AS current_employer,
    ad.Address_line1              AS address_line_1,
    NULLIF(ad.Address_line2, '')  AS address_line_2,
    ad.City                       AS city,
    ad.ZipCode                    AS postcode,
    ad.Country                    AS country,
    LOWER(lh.Source)              AS source,
    LOWER(lh.Pipeline_Stage)      AS status,
    NULL                          AS linkedin_url,
    p.CreatedBy                   AS owner_user_id,
    p.CreatedAt                   AS created_at
FROM Cobaltdesk_Legacy.dbo.Person p
LEFT JOIN Cobaltdesk_Legacy.dbo.Addresses ad ON ad.AddressID = p.AddressID
OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 eh.Title, eh.PlaceofWork FROM Cobaltdesk_Legacy.dbo.EmpHist eh
             JOIN Cobaltdesk_Legacy.dbo.Emp_Profile ep ON ep.Emp_ProfileID = eh.Emp_ID
             WHERE ep.Person_ID = p.Person_ID ORDER BY eh.Started_At DESC) cj
OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 h.Source, h.Pipeline_Stage FROM Cobaltdesk_Legacy.dbo.Req_Hired h
             WHERE h.Invoiced_PersonID = p.Person_ID ORDER BY h.CreatedAt DESC, h.Req_HiredID DESC) lh
WHERE (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Cobaltdesk_Legacy.dbo.Associates s WHERE s.Person_ID = p.Person_ID));

USE Migration_Staging;

TRUNCATE TABLE mid.Jobs;

INSERT INTO mid.Jobs (
    job_id,
    client_id,
    contact_id,
    title,
    employment_type,
    salary_min,
    salary_max,
    rate,
    rate_unit,
    location,
    status,
    owner_user_id,
    opened_at,
    closed_at,
    description
)
SELECT
    r.ReqID                                                              AS job_id,
    r.AccountID                                                          AS client_id,
    r.AssociateID                                                        AS contact_id,
    r.Req_Title                                                          AS title,
    LOWER(r.Worktype)                                                    AS employment_type,
    rt.Salary                                                            AS salary_min,
    NULL                                                                 AS salary_max,
    rt.BillRate                                                          AS rate,
    CASE WHEN rt.BillRate IS NOT NULL THEN 'day' END                     AS rate_unit,
    ad.City                                                              AS location,
    CASE WHEN r.Deleted = 1 THEN 'deleted' ELSE LOWER(r.StatusText) END  AS status,
    r.CreatedBy                                                          AS owner_user_id,
    CAST(r.StartDate AS DATE)                                            AS opened_at,
    CAST(r.EndDate AS DATE)                                              AS closed_at,
    r.Req_Description                                                    AS description
FROM Cobaltdesk_Legacy.dbo.Req r
OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 rr.BillRate, rr.Salary FROM Cobaltdesk_Legacy.dbo.Req_Rates rr WHERE rr.Req_ID = r.ReqID ORDER BY rr.Req_RateID) rt
LEFT JOIN Cobaltdesk_Legacy.dbo.Addresses ad ON ad.AddressID = r.Address_ID;

USE Migration_Staging;

TRUNCATE TABLE mid.Documents;

INSERT INTO mid.Documents (
    document_id,
    entity_type,
    entity_id,
    file_name,
    file_type,
    storage_path,
    uploaded_at
)
SELECT
    'D' + CAST(d.Doc_ID AS NVARCHAR(20))                                                                                                                                                                  AS document_id,
    CASE d.ObjectType WHEN 'Person' THEN CASE WHEN pc.AssociateID IS NOT NULL THEN 'contact' ELSE 'candidate' END WHEN 'Associate' THEN 'contact' WHEN 'Req' THEN 'job' WHEN 'Account' THEN 'client' END  AS entity_type,
    CASE WHEN d.ObjectType = 'Person' AND pc.AssociateID IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(pc.AssociateID AS NVARCHAR(50)) ELSE CAST(d.Doc_AssocID AS NVARCHAR(50)) END                                               AS entity_id,
    RIGHT(d.Path, CHARINDEX('/', REVERSE(d.Path)) - 1)                                                                                                                                                    AS file_name,
    LOWER(RIGHT(d.Path, CHARINDEX('.', REVERSE(d.Path)) - 1))                                                                                                                                             AS file_type,
    d.Path                                                                                                                                                                                                AS storage_path,
    d.CreatedAt                                                                                                                                                                                           AS uploaded_at
FROM Cobaltdesk_Legacy.dbo.Documents d
OUTER APPLY (SELECT MIN(s.AssociateID) AS AssociateID FROM Cobaltdesk_Legacy.dbo.Associates s WHERE d.ObjectType = 'Person' AND s.Person_ID = d.Doc_AssocID) pc;

INSERT INTO mid.Documents (
    document_id,
    entity_type,
    entity_id,
    file_name,
    file_type,
    storage_path,
    uploaded_at
)
SELECT
    'CV' + CAST(c.Doc_ID AS NVARCHAR(20))                      AS document_id,
    'candidate'                                                AS entity_type,
    c.CV_AssocID                                               AS entity_id,
    RIGHT(c.Path, CHARINDEX('/', REVERSE(c.Path)) - 1)         AS file_name,
    LOWER(RIGHT(c.Path, CHARINDEX('.', REVERSE(c.Path)) - 1))  AS file_type,
    c.Path                                                     AS storage_path,
    c.CreatedAt                                                AS uploaded_at
FROM Cobaltdesk_Legacy.dbo.CV_Docs c;

    inv.Currency                   AS currency,
    inv.NETAmount                  AS net_amount,
    inv.Amount - inv.NETAmount     AS vat_amount,
    inv.Amount                     AS gross_amount,
    CAST(inv.InvoiceDate AS DATE)  AS invoice_date,
    CAST(inv.DateDue AS DATE)      AS due_date,
    inv.[Desc]                     AS description,
    inv.CreatedBy                  AS added_by
FROM Cobaltdesk_Legacy.dbo.Invoice inv
LEFT JOIN Cobaltdesk_Legacy.dbo.InvoiceTypes it ON it.InvoiceType_ID = inv.InvoiceType_ID;
